pool.b.langzeitverletzt_anliegen_gruss: Coach, do you have a minute for me?
Coach, may I ask you for a talk?
pool.b.langzeitverletzt_anliegen_lage: I have been out for so long, and I see the team moving on without me.
Rehab drags on, and with every week my worry about what becomes of me here grows.
pool.b.langzeitverletzt_anliegen_lage.hi: I have been sitting in rehab for weeks and nobody tells me what happens afterwards!
For months I have been hobbling around here and nobody explains what awaits me!
pool.b.langzeitverletzt_anliegen_lage.lo: I would do anything for this club, but being injured for so long gnaws at me.
I like it here and want to stay, but the long absence worries me about my future.
pool.b.langzeitverletzt_anliegen_lage.eh: Every day on the treatment table is a day someone else takes my place.
I grind in rehab like never before, but I fear the competition has taken my spot by now.
pool.b.langzeitverletzt_anliegen_lage.we: Half a year without playing is lost time, and I wonder how much longer I should wait.
The long absence counts double in my career, and I am thinking about what that means for my future.
pool.b.langzeitverletzt_anliegen_lage.se: I swallowed it for a long time, but the long absence gets to me more than I show.
The longer I am gone, the quieter it gets around me, and that hurts.
pool.b.mentor_gibt_faehigkeit_gruss: Do you have a minute? There is news from training.
Boss, do you have a moment? I have something good to report.
pool.b.mentor_gibt_faehigkeit_lage: {name} has picked up a special skill from his mentor, you can already see it in training, or he is at least very close.
Working with the mentor is paying off: {name} almost has a special skill he took over from him.
pool.b.mentor_gibt_faehigkeit_lage.hitzi: {name} walks around as if he had long overtaken his mentor since picking up his special skill!
Since {name} mastered his mentor's skill, he acts in the dressing room as if the place belonged to him!
pool.b.mentor_gibt_faehigkeit_lage.loyal: {name} raves about his mentor and says he would never have learned the new special skill without him.
{name} has taken over his mentor's special skill and speaks about him with great gratitude.
pool.b.mentor_gibt_faehigkeit_lage.ehrge: {name} wants to master his mentor's special skill completely and is already asking about the next one.
The new special skill has whetted {name}'s appetite, he wants to learn everything from his mentor.
pool.b.mentor_gibt_faehigkeit_lage.wechs: {name} knows exactly that a special skill like this makes him more interesting to other clubs.
With his mentor's skill in his luggage {name} sees his market value rise and knows it.
pool.b.mentor_gibt_faehigkeit_lage.sensi: {name} does not yet trust his own progress and keeps asking me whether he really has the special skill.
{name} has taken over a special skill from his mentor but seems more unsure than proud.
pool.b.faehigkeit_verloren_position_grus: Do you have a minute? It is about a player.
Boss, I need a quick word about a player.
pool.b.faehigkeit_verloren_position_lage: {name} has lost a special skill through his new position, one he no longer needs there, and he is attached to it.
Since {name} has been playing in the new position for a long time, his old special skill has faded, and he mourns it.
{name} is raging because the new position took his special skill away!
{name} will not let it slide that he lost a special skill through the change of position!
{name} took over the new position without grumbling, but losing a special skill hits him hard.
{name} changed position for the club, and in doing so lost a special skill that meant a lot to him.
{name} wants to be the best everywhere and is annoyed that he lost a special skill in the new position.
One special skill less means one edge less for {name}, and he does not want to accept that.
{name} lost a special skill through the new position and sees that as a reason to think about his future.
Losing a special skill in the new position gives {name} reason to doubt his place here.
{name} feels somewhat devalued by losing a special skill in the new position.
That his special skill vanished in the new position gnaws at {name} more than he shows.
